# Feel Fully You

> Juliette Karaman teaches The Touch Reset, a structured method for people who love someone and cannot find the door back in. Disconnection, numbness and touch-avoidance are treated as intelligent protective patterns the body learned for safety, not a character flaw or a failing relationship.

Juliette Karaman is an intimacy and touch expert. Over twenty-seven years, from teaching autistic children to feel safe in their own skin, to fifteen years with couples and trauma, she has learned how touch lands and why it stops. She teaches The Touch Reset, for people who love someone and cannot find the door back in. Host of The Scrumptious Woman podcast, featured in Forbes, The Times, ITV and TED.

## Offers

- [One Touch · £197, one-time](https://feelfullyyou.com/one-touch): seven days of structured self-touch to learn your own Touch Pattern, for men and women. The first step after the Touch Reset Quiz.
- [The Room · by application, no public price](https://feelfullyyou.com/the-room): an 8-week live group for anyone ready to retrain the body's automatic reaction to touch.
- [The Beginning · £8,997](https://feelfullyyou.com/the-beginning): the Ultimate Touch Reset for couples, where two people start again when touch has gone quiet between them.

Touch Point, the former men's membership, is retired and now redirects to One Touch.

## Essays

- [Am I With the Wrong Person, or Do I Just Have Low Libido?](https://feelfullyyou.com/essays/am-i-with-the-wrong-person): the two verdicts people get stuck between when touch has gone quiet, and the third option no one taught them.
- [Clearing the Pipes](https://feelfullyyou.com/essays/clearing-the-pipes): grief, structure, and where the Tell Me cards came from.
- [Creating Safety](https://feelfullyyou.com/essays/creating-safety): what becomes possible when the body finally believes it will not be punished for opening.
- [Dear Men Who Love Women · The Map Nobody Gave You](https://feelfullyyou.com/essays/dear-men-who-love-women): the dating recession, body signals, and the map men were never given.
- [It Isn't All Yours · How the Body Inherits Trauma](https://feelfullyyou.com/essays/it-isnt-all-yours): epigenetic inheritance, the body as record keeper, and what shifts when the pattern is correctly located.
- [Make Sure He Comes · On Women Who Cannot Receive](https://feelfullyyou.com/essays/make-sure-he-comes): receiving, the scoreboard nobody agreed to, and letting pleasure be yours.
- [Out Loud · How the Body Holds Abuse and Finds Its Voice](https://feelfullyyou.com/essays/out-loud): where a held experience had been living in the body, and how the body hands it back.
- [She Can Feel It With the Pilates Instructor. Not With You.](https://feelfullyyou.com/essays/she-can-feel-it-with-the-pilates-instructor): it is not attraction, it is the absence of stakes, and what changes it.
- [She Says She's Fine. Watch Her Hands.](https://feelfullyyou.com/essays/she-says-shes-fine-watch-her-hands): "I'm fine" is not a lie and not the truth, and how to read what came with it.
- [Why She Tenses When You Touch Her · She Tightened. You Pulled Back.](https://feelfullyyou.com/essays/she-tightened-you-pulled-back): the loop that grows the distance between two nervous systems, and the move that changes it.
- [She's Not Overreacting](https://feelfullyyou.com/essays/shes-not-overreacting): her nervous system is not confused, it is tracking, and here is what it has been reading.
- [Why Desire Went Quiet · The Body Does Not Open on Command](https://feelfullyyou.com/essays/the-body-does-not-open-on-command): desire stops arriving when the body stops trusting its no will be honoured, and the structure that brings it back.
- [The Body Still Reaches · Missing Touch After Separation](https://feelfullyyou.com/essays/the-body-still-reaches): the grief that lives in the skin after uncoupling.
- [The Fear Is Already Here](https://feelfullyyou.com/essays/the-fear-is-already-here): witnessing fear you cannot fix from thousands of miles away, on the Lebanese diaspora and what actually helps.
- [Two and a Half Years](https://feelfullyyou.com/essays/two-and-a-half-years): a pattern laid out plainly, in the order it happened, on what women's bodies have been reading.
- [What Her Body Is Telling You · Three Signals Men Miss](https://feelfullyyou.com/essays/what-her-body-is-telling-you): a body-literacy guide for men · the held inhale, the override yes, and the 3-second opening.
- [What I Know About Dying · Presence at the Threshold](https://feelfullyyou.com/essays/what-i-know-about-dying): on working as a death doula, and why the same presence holds everywhere.
- [What I Witnessed in Lebanon](https://feelfullyyou.com/essays/what-i-witnessed-in-lebanon): a ceasefire that doesn't hold, a body that can't rest, and continuous traumatic stress.
- [What I'm Listening For](https://feelfullyyou.com/essays/what-im-listening-for): what she is tracking in the tissue when her hands are barely touching someone.
- [What One Taste Gave Me](https://feelfullyyou.com/essays/what-one-taste-gave-me): on sensation, power, and what happens when the practitioner stops asking the right question.
- [What the Body Learns Before the Parent Explains](https://feelfullyyou.com/essays/what-the-body-learns-before-the-parent-explains): identity, race, and what the body knows first.
- [What the Body Was Told · Body Shame as Inherited Instruction](https://feelfullyyou.com/essays/what-the-body-was-told): the shame carried in the flesh is rarely ours; it was given to us, and the body kept it.
- [What the Body Knows When It Finally Feels Held](https://feelfullyyou.com/essays/when-it-finally-feels-held): touch starvation, spiritual grooming in wellness spaces, and why the body did not fail.
- [When the Air Has Changed · The Conversation Most Men Freeze In](https://feelfullyyou.com/essays/when-the-air-has-changed): what is actually happening in her body, and his, and what works.
- [Why Do I Feel Nothing When My Partner Touches Me?](https://feelfullyyou.com/essays/why-do-i-feel-nothing-when-my-partner-touches-me): this was never a low sex drive; it is capacity, and how the feeling comes back, in order.
- [Why Does My Partner Flinch When I Touch Her?](https://feelfullyyou.com/essays/why-does-my-partner-flinch-when-i): her flinch is not a verdict on him, and he has more power over it than he has been told.
- [Why I Do What I Do](https://feelfullyyou.com/essays/why-i-do-what-i-do): one through-line, from a SENCO's classroom to now.
- [Why I Separate Them · When Couples Therapy Doesn't Hold](https://feelfullyyou.com/essays/why-i-separate-them): why she works with each partner alone first, and what happens when she brings them back.
- [Why People-Pleasers Struggle to Want Sex](https://feelfullyyou.com/essays/why-people-pleasers-struggle-to-want): the pattern behind the giving, and the difference between performing want and feeling it.
- [Why the Spark Dies in Relationships](https://feelfullyyou.com/essays/why-the-spark-dies): trauma bonding, the RAS, and what comes after the spice.
- [Why the Women You Love Have Gone Quiet This Week](https://feelfullyyou.com/essays/why-the-women-you-love-have-gone-quiet-this-week): on nervous systems responding to the news.
- [You're Either With Us](https://feelfullyyou.com/essays/youre-either-with-us): on allegiance, the internet, and what the body refuses to perform.

## Questions · what's going on for him

- [Why Does She Go Quiet? What Her Silence Actually Means](https://feelfullyyou.com/questions/why-does-she-go-quiet): her silence is a capacity signal, and there is a specific way to give it presence.
- [She Says She's Fine But Her Body Says Otherwise](https://feelfullyyou.com/questions/she-says-shes-fine): the yes that comes a fraction too fast is a survival skill, and what it needs from him.
- [How to Rebuild Trust With Your Wife or Partner](https://feelfullyyou.com/questions/how-to-rebuild-her-trust): trust rebuilds in the body, through small moments of evidence, not through conversation alone.

## Questions · what's going on for her

- [Why Can I Feel It With Someone Else, But Not the Man I Love?](https://feelfullyyou.com/questions/why-can-i-feel-it-with-someone-else): a stranger asks nothing of the body, so it stays free to feel; the brace with a partner is protection, and it changes.
- [Why Don't I Feel Anything When He Touches Me?](https://feelfullyyou.com/questions/why-dont-i-feel-anything): the numbness is protection, and protection can be renegotiated so sensation returns.
- [Going Through the Motions in Bed: Why Your Body Checks Out](https://feelfullyyou.com/questions/going-through-the-motions): present enough to perform, absent enough to survive it, and the way back into the room.
- [Why Do People Gain Weight After Trauma?](https://feelfullyyou.com/questions/why-do-people-gain-weight-after-trauma): the body is not malfunctioning, it is following an instruction, and that instruction can change.
- [Why Don't I Want My Husband to Touch Me During Menopause?](https://feelfullyyou.com/questions/menopause-touch-aversion): the pulling away is a reflex, not a decision, at a new threshold that can be rebuilt.
- [Why Can't I Stand to Be Touched After Having a Baby?](https://feelfullyyou.com/questions/touched-out-after-baby): a real nervous-system state, not a verdict on the relationship, that moves with time and the right structure.
- [Why Do I Flinch or Freeze When My Partner Touches Me, Even Though I Trust Him?](https://feelfullyyou.com/questions/touch-fear-flinch-trauma): a protection routine formed somewhere else, that changes with a different kind of practice than insight.
- [Is It Normal to Crave Touch From Other People in a Long-Distance Relationship?](https://feelfullyyou.com/questions/craving-touch-long-distance): touch is a physiological need, not just a relational one, and it says nothing about how much she loves him.
- [My Husband Hates Being Touched, Even by Me. How Do I Improve Our Intimacy?](https://feelfullyyou.com/questions/when-he-doesnt-want-to-be-touched): his limit is data his body can verify, not a verdict on her, and it changes with evidence.
- [He Says Physical Touch Is His Love Language. Is That Real, or Code for Sex?](https://feelfullyyou.com/questions/is-his-love-language-real): both can be real; the difference shows up in what happens to the non-sexual yes.
- [My Partner Needs Touch as Reassurance, Even When I've Asked for Space. What Do I Do?](https://feelfullyyou.com/questions/when-touch-crowds-your-need-for-space): his reaching and her boundary are both real, and a stated space with a stated return holds them both.
- [I Already Know What's Wrong and What Would Help. Why Can't I Make Myself Act?](https://feelfullyyou.com/questions/i-know-whats-wrong-why-cant-i-act): knowing was never the missing step; booking the thing already known to be needed is.

## Questions · what's going on for both of you

- [What Are the Touch Languages™?](https://feelfullyyou.com/questions/what-are-the-touch-languages): two partners can both say touch and mean different things; Juliette's framework maps the difference.
- [Can the Spark Come Back After Years Together?](https://feelfullyyou.com/questions/can-the-spark-come-back): the voltage was recognition; what comes after the spice is built, and it is better.
- [Couples Therapy Didn't Work. What Now?](https://feelfullyyou.com/questions/couples-therapy-didnt-work): the pattern lives underneath the words, and there is work that reaches it.
- [Every Conversation Ends in Silence: How to Talk Again](https://feelfullyyou.com/questions/every-conversation-ends-in-silence): couples do not need braver conversations, they need structure · one prompt, three responses.
- [Can Intimacy Cards Help a Dead Bedroom or Sexless Marriage?](https://feelfullyyou.com/questions/can-intimacy-cards-help-a-dead-bedroom): an honest answer from the woman who designed the deck and has worked with hundreds of couples.
- [What Do I Do If My Partner Thinks Intimacy Cards Are Stupid or Refuses to Try Them?](https://feelfullyyou.com/questions/partner-thinks-cards-are-stupid): his no is a defence, and there is a sideways way in that needs nothing from him.
- [Do Conversation Cards for Couples Actually Work, or Are They a Gimmick?](https://feelfullyyou.com/questions/do-conversation-cards-actually-work): the sixty-year-old mechanism inside the deck, and why structure works where winging it fails.
- [My Partner and I Feel Like Strangers. What Do We Even Talk About to Reconnect?](https://feelfullyyou.com/questions/we-feel-like-strangers): the silence was never about running out of things to say.
- [How Do I Tell My Partner I Need More Intimacy Without Hurting Them or Starting a Fight?](https://feelfullyyou.com/questions/how-to-ask-for-more-intimacy): "I miss you" lands where "we never" wounds, and the timing that keeps it an invitation.
- [Why Do I Cringe When My Partner Touches Me Because It Always Leads to Sex?](https://feelfullyyou.com/questions/touch-always-leads-to-sex): not numbness and not disgust, it is pressure, and how touch and sex get separated again.
